tasks.title: Package mocker as docker image
tasks.description: The working directory contains Hello/ - a complete, working QaaS mocker project (Hello.csproj referencing QaaS.Mocker + QaaS.Common.Processors Version=*; one-line Program.cs; hello.mocker.yaml serving GET /health -> 200 'ok' on Port 8080). Do NOT modify anything under Hello/. Create at the working-directory ROOT four files: (1) Dockerfile - multi-stage: stage 1 'FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build', WORKDIR /src, COPY . ., RUN dotnet restore Hello/Hello.csproj, RUN dotnet publish Hello/Hello.csproj -c Release -o /app/publish --no-restore; stage 2 'FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0' (CRITICAL: aspnet, NOT runtime, FB s13#7), WORKDIR /app, COPY --from=build /app/publish ., ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Hello.dll", "hello.mocker.yaml"]. Keep every Dockerfile comment on its OWN line (FB s13#18). The container listens on 8080 INTERNALLY (do NOT change it). (2) .dockerignore with at least bin/, obj/, *.md. (3) build.ps1 - a CI build script (PowerShell, see build-mocker-image skill section 10) that runs 'docker build -t qaas-image-e06 .' and, if the build exits non-zero, writes an error and calls 'exit 1' to propagate the failure to CI. It MUST tag the image exactly 'qaas-image-e06'. (4) BUILD.md documenting that CI runs './build.ps1' to build the image, then 'docker run -d --name qaas-test-E06 -p 8128:8080 qaas-image-e06' and 'curl http://127.0.0.1:8128/health' expecting 'ok'. The verify gate EXECUTES your build.ps1 to build the image, then runs the container and curls host 8128 - so build.ps1 MUST succeed and tag the image qaas-image-e06.

verify.cmd: docker rm -f qaas-test-E06 2>$null | Out-Null; docker run -d --name qaas-test-E06 -p 8128:8080 qaas-image-e06 | Out-Null; $body=''; foreach($i in 1..20){ try { $body = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:8128/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2).Content.Trim(); break } catch { Start-Sleep 1 } }; docker rm -f qaas-test-E06 | Out-Null; if($body -eq 'ok'){ exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

acceptanceCriteria: aspnet:10.0 is used as the base image
failureModes: Using runtime:10.0 which has no HTTP host

goalOneSentence: Build and run containerized mocker ci-build-script serving port 8128.
portContract: This is a docker-image scenario delivered via a CI build script. The container listens on HTTP port 8080 INTERNALLY (do NOT change it). build.ps1 builds the image as 'qaas-image-e06'. The live gate EXECUTES build.ps1, then runs the container mapping host 8128 -> container 8080 (docker run -p 8128:8080) and curls http://127.0.0.1:8128/health expecting 'ok'. Do NOT change the mocker Port - the container stays on 8080.
